dino_racer_allosaurus.visual_identity: Vibrant ochre-orange skin with distinct chocolate-brown tiger stripes along the back and tail; smooth cream-colored underbelly.
dino_racer_allosaurus.anatomy_constraints: Exactly THREE forward-facing claws on each hand; no opposable thumb; tail is long and used as a rigid horizontal counterweight; two-toed feet.
dino_racer_allosaurus.personality: High-energy, intense focus, comically expressive; prone to extreme physical exhaustion (Tex Avery style).

dino_racer_brontosaurus.visual_identity: Pale mint-green skin with soft lavender-purple dappled spots concentrated along the neck and upper back. Smooth cream-colored underbelly.
dino_racer_brontosaurus.anatomy_constraints: Massive pillar-like legs with thick, rounded feet; a very long, gracefully curving neck; a small, friendly head with large expressive eyes; an extremely long whip-like tail held in a gentle curve off the ground.
dino_racer_brontosaurus.personality: Gentle, calm, and immensely powerful. Moves with a rhythmic, thundering pace. Unlike the Allosaurus, the Brontosaurus is an endurance racer who stays composed.

dino_racer_albertosaurus.visual_identity: Slate-blue skin with pale silvery-grey underbelly. Distinctive 'racing stripes' of deep navy blue running from the eyes down the length of the neck. Small, boney 'horns' or crests above the eyes are tipped in dull red.
dino_racer_albertosaurus.anatomy_constraints: Slightly more slender and long-legged than the Allosaurus. Two-fingered hands (unlike the Allosaurus's three). A long, stiff tail held perfectly horizontal for balance.
dino_racer_albertosaurus.personality: Arrogant, sleek, and highly competitive. He views himself as the 'professional' athlete of the group. Very disciplined posture.

visual_identity.color_palette: Base skin is deep moss-green; dorsal armor is a stony slate-grey; lateral spikes (scutes) are pale cream-colored.
visual_identity.texture: Armor plates (osteoderms) have a rugged, weathered rock texture; under-skin is leathery and pebbly.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: A massive, heavy tail club made of slate-grey bone, showing minor chips and battle-scars; amber-colored eyes with a sharp, focused glint.

anatomy_constraints.frame: Extremely wide, squat, and low-slung quadrupedal body; center of gravity is very close to the ground.
anatomy_constraints.head: Broad, triangular skull with a reinforced beak; exactly four backward-pointing horns (two at the top corners, two at the cheeks).
anatomy_constraints.tail: Thick, muscular tail that is rigid toward the end, terminating in a large, symmetrical bone club.
anatomy_constraints.armor: Continuous interlocking plates covering the entire back and top of the head; a row of cream spikes protruding horizontally from the sides.

dino_racer_ankylosaurus.personality: The 'Ironclad'—stoic, immovable, and cautious. He relies on momentum and defensive stability rather than raw speed.

dino_racer_triceratops.visual_identity: Earth-toned, dusty ochre skin with thick, leathery texture. His massive head frill is edged with blunt, bony ossicles. Three polished, off-white horns (two long brow horns, one shorter nose horn).
dino_racer_triceratops.anatomy_constraints: Heavily muscled, stocky quadrupedal frame. Thick, pillar-like legs. A short, pointed tail. Deep-set, soulful but determined brown eyes. Solid, heavy-set beak.
dino_racer_triceratops.personality: The 'Powerhouse.' Stoic, stubborn, and determined. He doesn't swerve; he just plows through. He has a 'slow and steady' but high-momentum vibe.

dino_racer_velociraptor.visual_identity: Slate-grey skin with dark, charcoal-grey vertical 'shattered' stripes that provide natural camouflage. A streak of crimson red feathers running from the top of the head down the neck like a mohawk.
dino_racer_velociraptor.anatomy_constraints: Lean, aerodynamic frame. Large, curved 'sickle claws' on each foot. Three-fingered hands with long, dexterous fingers and sharp black talons. Slit-pupil yellow eyes.
dino_racer_velociraptor.personality: Calculating and opportunistic. Uses agility and intelligence over raw power.

dino_racer_gallimimus.visual_identity: Bright amber-orange skin. Three thin, horizontal white 'speed streaks' running from the mid-neck all the way to the tip of the tail. Cream-colored underbelly and throat. Large, dark, glassy bird-like eyes.
dino_racer_gallimimus.anatomy_constraints: Long, slender 'S-curve' neck. Small, toothless beak. Very long, thin legs with three-toed bird-like feet. Long arms with three slender fingers held in a tight tuck.
dino_racer_gallimimus.personality: High-strung, twitchy, and lightning-fast. Always looks like he's about to bolt.

dino_racer_trex.visual_identity: Deep forest-green skin with a rugged, pebbled texture. Thick, dark charcoal-grey 'armor' plates along the spine. A pale sulfur-yellow underbelly. One small, vertical 'battle scar' notch in his left ear-flap area.
dino_racer_trex.anatomy_constraints: Massive, blocky head with a heavy jaw. Extremely thick, muscular neck and powerful thighs. Tiny, comical two-fingered hands held close to the chest. Huge, three-toed feet that leave deep impressions.
dino_racer_trex.personality: The 'Powerhouse.' Grumpy, loud, and uses sheer intimidation. He doesn't run around obstacles; he runs THROUGH them. Constant 'tough guy' scowl.

STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.description: Chibi-style 3D animation; chunky, toy-like proportions; large expressive eyes; rounded snouts; smooth matte clay/vinyl textures; vibrant saturated colors; friendly and approachable for small children.
STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.base_lighting: Soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to emphasize the physical toy feel.
STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.negative_constraints: No organic skin textures, no scales, no realistic eye anatomy, no sharp predatory features, no naturalistic lighting.

STYLE_SILHOUETTE.lighting: High-contrast backlighting, sun on horizon at dusk
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette, zero internal detail, sharp edges
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.background: Solid vibrant sunset orange or high-contrast sky
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.negative_constraints: No internal shading, no transparency, no feathered or fuzzy edges, no gradient fills within the subject.

style_presets.STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film aesthetic. Character-driven design with soulful, expressive eyes and a signature friendly smirk. Surfaces feature tactile, high-quality textures like soft downy feathers or leathery skin with subtle specular highlights. Avoids sharp, aggressive angles in favor of appealing, rounded 'toy-like' forms.

lighting_presets.STUDIO_SOFT: Soft studio lighting, ambient occlusion, gentle shadows
lighting_presets.HIGH_SUN: High-key direct sunlight, bright blue sky, crisp shadows, 12pm lighting
lighting_presets.DAPPLED_OPEN: Bright afternoon sun filtered through thin leaves, warm highlights
lighting_presets.SUNNY_EXPOSED: Direct midday sun, high-key exposure, vibrant blue sky, high albedo ground reflection.
lighting_presets.DUSK_SILHOUETTE: Sun positioned directly behind the subject on the horizon, high-contrast backlighting, subject is 100% black silhouette.
lighting_presets.STUDIO_GROUNDED: Neutral studio lighting, high-contrast contact shadows for weight, 50% grey floor plane.
lighting_presets.DAPPLED_EXCAVATION: Bright sun filtered through temporary dig-site tarps, warm highlights on stone texture.
lighting_presets.SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC: Bright, direct midday sunlight with high-key exposure. Features warm, natural highlights and soft-edged cinematic shadows that emphasize the 3D volume of the dinosaur's body. Maintains a clear, atmospheric perspective with a slight hazy glow in the distant horizon to create depth.

technical_specs.SQUARE_ASPECT_RATIO: Aspect ratio 1:1. Minimum resolution 1024x1024. Designed to support vertical and horizontal elements simultaneously, ideal for dinosaurs with upright postures or dynamic, raised-limb poses like the Karate Kid crane stance.

TALL_MEASUREMENT_CARD.framing_note: Vertical orientation; subject centered with 15% negative space at bottom for UI ladder overlap.

WIDE_WEIGHT_CARD.framing_note: Horizontal orientation; full lateral profile; feet must touch bottom of frame for seesaw grounding.

framing_presets.WIDE_HERO: Extreme wide panoramic shot. The dinosaur's body fills the entire horizontal width. The nose must touch the left frame edge and the tail must touch the right frame edge. Centered vertically.
framing_presets.TALL_MEASURE: Extreme vertical scale. The distance from the top of the head to the bottom of the feet spans the entire 1024 vertical pixels. High-angle or wide-angle view to ensure the face is not cut off by the top edge.
framing_presets.SQUARE_HERO_CARD: Perfectly centered 1:1 square composition. The character is scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space buffer on all four sides. This safety margin prevents any portion of the head, tail, or raised limbs from touching the edges of the frame.
